newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's c.bank drains 1.34 bln dirhams.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's c.bank drains 1.34 bln dirhams.

text.p: Morocco's Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) withdrew 1.34 billion dirhams from the money market for one week at its repurchase auction, the bank said on Wednesday.
The bank received bids totalling 405 million dirhams and allocated 295 million dirhams at 6.5 percent interest rate. That was less than the 1.635 billion dirhams leaving the market this week.
The bank satisfied 72.84 percent of the demand for liquidity.
The next auction is due on June 25.
